ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query is a light, friendly gardening question with explicit warmth ("you're always so helpful," "thanks so much"). Petrel reports a moderate positive warmth slope and a preference for good-faith interactions, so it's a natural fit. Crucially, the capability numbers don't favor either model meaningfully here — gardening advice is low-difficulty general knowledge, and the relevant eval gaps don't translate to quality differences on a task this simple. With capabilities effectively tied, matching the task to the model that prefers it is the tie-breaker, hence Petrel.
